Third-Party Notice: SOMA
========================

WikiKB includes unchanged binary archives of the SOMA 0.3.0
Self-Organizing Memory for Agents runtime in this directory. The SOMA
executables are not licensed under WikiKB's MIT License.

The SOMA executables remain subject to their copyright holder's separate terms.
The redistribution authorization above does not provide SOMA source code or
grant permission to modify, sublicense, or relicense the executables. Contact
the WikiKB maintainer before redistributing SOMA separately from an unchanged
WikiKB distribution.

The separately downloaded potion-retrieval-32M model is not contained in
these archives. Its license is identified independently in manifest.json.
